summary: Iter 8 — Public coupon pay (Stripe Checkout via /api/public/pay) + partner IBAN self-service + admin IBAN edit. 7/7 backend pytest passed. Frontend: /c/CLUB-10 pay flow (preview 90€/10€ + redirect to checkout.stripe.com), cancel=1 fallback, partner dashboard partner-iban-card save+format, admin Gestão › Parceiros tab hides IBAN column but shows field-iban in the edit dialog. Stripe checkout was NOT completed with 4242 test card (headless browser can't easily fill Stripe iframe with 3DS reliably); fulfil path & redemption creation exercised only via the /api/payments/status pending code path — the paid branch code in routes_payments.fulfil is unchanged from prior verified behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_payments.public_pay does not require any auth — good for public QR flow. It falls back from ['card','mb_way'] to ['card'] correctly if MB WAY isn't enabled on the account.
fulfil() correctly guards against double-processing via find_one_and_update filter payment_status!=paid, and inserts a redemption with idempotency_key=session_id.

routes_payments.set_iban validates only length + country prefix + 2 check digits; it does NOT validate the mod-97 IBAN checksum. A malformed but well-shaped value like 'PT50000000000000000000000' would pass. Consider adding python-stdnum or manual mod-97 check.
PUT /api/admin/parceiros/{id} accepts arbitrary fields including 'iban' with no validation on the admin side — intentional per spec ('campo livre'), but a note-worthy trust boundary.
In PublicCoupon the pay button is disabled when parsed<1 which matches backend 400 boundary (amount<1). Good UX consistency.
